variants.headline: Request for more shipping refused
variants.body: The home world has refused the colony's request for more shipping. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Home world declines route expansion request
variants.body: A colonial request for additional shipping has been rejected by the home world. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: No assent to the colony's shipping plea
variants.body: The colony's plea for more shipping has been refused. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
